name: io.github.wise-vision/ros2_mcp
title: ROS2 MCP
description: ROS2 MCP: list, subscribe, publish and call ROS 2 topics, services and actions via MCP (optional read-only mode)

environmentVariables.name: ROS2_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Read-only mode: when 1/true, tools that publish, call services or send/cancel action goals are not registered

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ROS_DISCOVERY_WARMUP
environmentVariables.description: Warm up ROS graph on first tool call to mitigate DDS discovery timing issues (true/false; default: auto-enabled in containers)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ROS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_SEC
environmentVariables.description: Max time (seconds) to wait during discovery warm-up

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ROS_DISCOVERY_STABLE_SEC
environmentVariables.description: Required 'no changes' window (seconds) before proceeding during discovery warm-up

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ROS_DISCOVERY_POLL_SEC
environmentVariables.description: Polling interval (seconds) used during discovery warm-up

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ROS_DISCOVERY_DELAY_SEC
environmentVariables.description: Minimum delay (seconds) before the first tool proceeds (in addition to stability check)
